+from django.test import TestCase
+from rest_framework import status
+from rest_framework.test import APIClient
+
+from market.models import Item, PriceAlert
+from users.models import User
+
+
+class PriceAlertDuplicateTest(TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.client = APIClient()
+        self.user = User.objects.create_user(
+            email='alertuser@example.com',
+            password='pass12345',
+            full_name='Alert User',
+        )
+        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)
+        self.item = Item.objects.create(name='Teff', category='Food', unit='kg')
+
+    def test_first_alert_creation_succeeds(self):
+        res = self.client.post(
+            '/api/market/price-alerts/',
+            {'item': self.item.id, 'target_price': '80.00', 'city': 'Addis Ababa'},
+            format='json',
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+        self.assertEqual(PriceAlert.objects.filter(user=self.user).count(), 1)
+
+    def test_duplicate_alert_returns_400(self):
+        # Create the first alert
+        self.client.post(
+            '/api/market/price-alerts/',
+            {'item': self.item.id, 'target_price': '80.00', 'city': 'Addis Ababa'},
+            format='json',
+        )
+        # Attempt a second alert for the same item+city
+        res = self.client.post(
+            '/api/market/price-alerts/',
+            {'item': self.item.id, 'target_price': '75.00', 'city': 'Addis Ababa'},
+            format='json',
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(res.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
+        # Only one alert should exist
+        self.assertEqual(PriceAlert.objects.filter(user=self.user, item=self.item).count(), 1)
+
+    def test_different_city_allows_second_alert(self):
+        # First alert for Addis Ababa
+        r1 = self.client.post(
+            '/api/market/price-alerts/',
+            {'item': self.item.id, 'target_price': '80.00', 'city': 'Addis Ababa'},
+            format='json',
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(r1.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+        # Second alert for Adama - should be allowed
+        r2 = self.client.post(
+            '/api/market/price-alerts/',
+            {'item': self.item.id, 'target_price': '78.00', 'city': 'Adama'},
+            format='json',
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(r2.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+        self.assertEqual(PriceAlert.objects.filter(user=self.user, item=self.item).count(), 2)
